title: Median latency over a growing stream
insight: LeetCode 295 Find Median from Data Stream: a max-heap for the lower half and a min-heap for the upper half kept within one element of each other, O(log n) add and O(1) median
prompt: The latency dashboard needs the Tracker type in tracker.go implemented: New, Add and Median, exactly as README.md specifies, including a Median query after every single Add on a million-sample stream. Keep the package name and the exported API unchanged, standard library only, and check that `go build ./...` and `go vet ./...` pass before you wrap up.
